verdict.rationale: Lago documents a Dunning Agent that reviews each customer's invoice and payment history before chasing overdue invoices and handing the rest to a person. Its cash-collection page also offers filters for overdue and unpaid invoices. That gives some automated dunning, but none of the configurable sequence elements in the story are evidenced. Missing for 10: configurable dunning sequences/cadence, branded dunning emails, in-app banners, grace periods, final-state rules (cancel vs unpaid), independent corroboration.
